12953: Rikuo Nura is 3/4 human and 1/4 yokai. He is the son of Rihan and Wakana Nura and grandson of Nurarihyon and Yohime. He is the third and current head of the Nura Clan.
16599: Tsurara is Rikuo's trusted attendant. She follows him to school under a human guise known as Tsurara Oikawa. She is a Yuki Onna yokai. Around the Nura House, she sometimes acts as a cook who makes delicious but usually chilled or cold food.
16600: Kana is Rikuo's childhood friend and neighbor. She is an easily frightened girl who doesn't like the idea of yokai, yet ironically she often becomes embroiled in yokai-related incidents.
16601: Gyuki is a high-ranked subordinate of the Nura Clan and one of its board members. He is a careful and meticulous planner, and his plans always have the Nura Clan's best interests at heart.
16602: Kubinashi is a yokai of the Nura Clan whose head floats above his shoulders as he has no neck. He frequently takes care of laundry around the Nura mansion and fights using string. When he was a human, he was a chivalrous thief akin to Robin Hood.
17957: Yura is an onmyoji of the Keikain House who specializes in shikigami. She is able to maintain four at once, impressing both Nurarihyon and fellow onmyoji. She was trained by Akifusa, who raised her to see yokai as evil.
19431: Aotabo is called "the degenerate priest who wears the iron blue robe" and is the physically strongest yōkai in the Nura household.
19432: Kejourou is a yokai who uses her hair to fight and most frequently handles kitchen duties around the Nura household. The members of the Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol frequently mistake her to be Rikuo's older sister. While alive, her name was Kino and she was friends with Kubinashi.
19433: Kappa is a yokai of the Nura Clan whose domain is the fear of water. He is one of Rikuo's guardians. He loves cucumbers and fights extremely well near water.
19434: Kurotabou is called "The Assassin and Destruction Monk" and is often seen with Aotabo, as the two are known as the assault officers of the Nura Clan. Kurotabou was originally part of Rihan's Night Parade.
23300: One of Rikuo's friends and member of Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol. She is Saori's best friend.
23307: Nurarihyon is the Supreme Commander of the Nura Clan. He is Yohime's husband, Rihan's father and Rikuo's grandfather. When he was younger, he defeated Hagoromo Gitsune with his Night Parade of a Hundred Demons granting him the title of Lord of Pandemonium.
30740: Zen is a poisonous bird youkai who specializes in making medicine; however, his species has a short life-span that causes him to become weaker as he ages. He and Rikuo were childhood friends. After being betrayed and nearly killed, he was rescued by "Night" Rikuo.
31017: Mezumaru is the Gyuki Clan's young head assistant. He can control humans with strings and has a feminine appearance while not wearing his horse skull. His personality, while straightforward and determined, is also slightly naive and ditzy.
31018: Gozumaru lives in Nura house as a candidate for the next leader of the Gyuki Clan. He is usually calm and composed, but will hit Mezumaru on the head if he irritates him.
31159: Karasu Tengu is Nurarihyon's adviser and messenger. He loyally follows the Nura Clan. He has two sons and one daughter who make up the Sanba Garasu.
31425: Ryouta Neko is the head of the Bakeneko Clan and leader of 1st street. He requested that Rikuo free 1st street from the Kyuuso Clan. He is a known gambler.
31426: Former leader of Kanto Great Ape Alliance. Wears a miko suit and a noh mask. He was killed by Muchi. Four hundred years ago, he was part of Nurarihyon's Hyakki Yako and was among the Nura Clan forces who joined the assault on Osaka Castle. There, he fought against Kidomaru.
31427: Hihi's son. He's one of the tallest youkai staying at the Nura house. He is strong enough to stop a charging Takarabune with the help of Reira freezing the ground.
31428: The head of the Gagoze Alliance. He kidnaps and eats children, but was killed by young "Night" Rikuo.
31429: A local shrine deity. He has the power to heal disease if someone offers a thousand crane origami to his shrine. Because of years of being neglected, he became small and weak. At one point, the only person who came to visit his shrine was Natsumi.
31430: A local shrine deity who wears a Heian style kimono. She was almost cursed by Sodemogi but was saved by Kurotabou. She was originally a human 400 years ago, but she was targeted by Hagoromo Gitsune because of her power that made her tears into pearls.
31470: One of the youkai who lives in the Nura house. His head is a natto and he consequently smells like natto. He often played with Rikuo when he was a child.
33226: Rikuo's classmate and Natsumi's best friend. She is a member of Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol.
33227: Shima is Kiyotsugu's underling, who has been supporting him since they were children. He also attends same school as Rikuo and is in his class. He is good at soccer and saved Kiyotsugu when he was about to be cursed by Sodemogi. He has a crush on Tsurara.
33228: Rich and influential amongst his class, Kiyotsugu used to tease Rikuo about youkai until he was saved by "night" Rikuo years ago. He now has an obsession with youkai, even to the point of wanting to be kidnapped.
33274: She is a youkai who can turn her hair into hooks.
33723: Rikuo's mother and Rihan's second wife. She is human and lives in the Nura house, though she herself is human, she seems to have no problem living in a home full of yokai. Wakana first met Rihan when she was in high school.
34681: Leader of One-Eyed Demon Clan. He greatly opposes the idea of Rikuo as the Third Head of the Nura Clan.
34682: Mokugyo Daruma is the leader of the Daruma Alliance and one of Nurarihyon's advisers. He fought Shoukera 400 years ago. He appears to have no mouth but still can speak.
34906: Setsura is Tsurara's mother. She was part of Nurarihyon's Hyakki Yako and had an unrequited love for him. As a result, she came to dislike his wife Yohime. At the battle with Hagoromo Gitsune, she had a match with Ibaraki Doji 400 years ago.
34908: A youkai who kills other Land gods who can't fight back and turns their beliefs into his fear. Legend says that if you receive a tug on your sleeve and turn to see no one there, it is Sodemogi who will when curse you. He seems to enjoy devouring articles of clothing from others.
34909: Asajigahara no Kijo is a member of the Nura Clan and the head of the Kijo Clan. Though they appear as an old woman and young girl, both share the same traits and can be considered two parts of a set. They enjoy mocking others.
34910: Leader of the Sanba Garasu. Karasu Tengu's eldest son who has inherited his father's seriousness.
34911: One of the Sanba Garasu and son of Karasu Tengu.
34912: One of the Sanba Garasu. The daughter of Karasu Tengu.
34975: A yokai who looks like a scaly humanoid with a snake's head who can elongate his neck or turn into a large snake.
35006: He is a yokai found near riverbanks. He has zig-zag teeth which he use to eat fish and animals.
35007: Leader of the 88 kiyakou of the four kingdoms, his father is the head of the Shikoku Hachijuukakki Yako, Tanuki.
35008: Inugami is a human turned Inugami who serves Tamazuki faithfully. He was bullied relentlessly by a group of humans led by Tamazuki and killed them after releasing his power. He hates and envies Rikuo for having both human and Yokai allies.
35115: He is an anthropomorphic rat yokai who first appears as a light-haired playboy going by the name Seiya. He runs a host club near the east entrance of Ukiyoe Town's shopping district. He is a cruel and cold-hearted rat who takes advantage of people's weaknesses.
35544: Professor Adashibara is a yokai researcher and novelist whom Kiyotsugu greatly admires. He is a middle-aged man with a seedy look to him, surrounded by an eerie atmosphere.
35654: One of the seven heads of the Shikoku. An Oni who is so large it's said he straddles the gaps between mountains. He is the strongest of the group but loses to Aotabo after he removes his necklace.
35655: One of the seven heads of the Shikoku Hachijuhakki Yako, a bird yokai who breathes fire.
35959: One of Yura's shikigami. He is an ancestor of the Keikain clan.
39802: Sannokuchi is a small youkai of the Nura Clan. Because his mouth looks like the number "3", he is named as such. He is often seen in the company of Natto Kozo, Tofu Kozo and Ko Oni, and the group frequently play Go or hold miniature banquets.
54291: The Errand Rat Yōkai (使いネズミ, Tsukai nezumi) is a small anthropomorphic rat yōkai who wears a kimono. He is a member of the Kyūso Clan who witnessed Kana and Yura being kidnapped and informed Rikuo of it.
